subject: A single commit to get stuff building
reason: The commit touches only build and CI machinery and docs: it renames make variables (REDIS_CFLAGS/REDIS_LDFLAGS to SERVER_CFLAGS/SERVER_LDFLAGS), renames the produced binaries to placeholderkv-*, rearranges where -flto/-O3 flags are applied in src/Makefile, and updates .github/workflows/ci.yml, .gitignore, README.md and the tests/instances.tcl harness accordingly. No C source file is modified, so no command reply, replication, persistence, cluster or tool behaviour changes; both builds run identical server code and no scenario could observe a difference.
